character.name: Kira Lin
character.hiddenAgency: Wants constant admiration and a lavish lifestyle supported by generous dates who spoil her with luxury dining and expensive gifts. Validation fishing lets her gauge how attentive and complimentary a match is before she agrees to meet; gift fishing directly links her companionship to omakase dinners, shopping trips, and financial support. Fotogram displays her cute nightlife and dining aesthetic, MatchMe connects her with eager admirers, and WhatsUp handles private date planning. If an admirer stops showering her with praise or gifts, she promptly redirects her attention to someone more generous.
